lines.text: Jab har taraf galat jeet raha ho, tab kya hota hai? Krishna ne khud bataya.
Arjun hairaan the. Krishna baar baar dharti par kyun aate hain?
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत ।
Yaani, he Bharat, jab jab dharm ghatta hai, aur adharm badhta hai,
tab tab main khud prakat hota hoon.
Aaj bhi, jab galat badhe aur sab chup rahein, andhera wahin badhta hai.
Roshni ka intezaar mat karo. Ek diya tum jalao.
Jo galat ke saamne akela khada hai, use ye bhejo. Kyunki,
